notes: Loss budget 5 dB on up to 2 km SMF with KR4 FEC; includes 2.5 dB optical coding gain from host RS-FEC (528,514) per Clause 91; maximum informative link length 2 km; bypass RS-FEC not supported; loss budget may include up to 1 dB MPI loss penalty. Unstressed receiver sensitivity at 5x10-5 BER; stressed SRS measured with 4WDM MSA conformance test signal at TP3 for 5x10-5 BER. TDP max 3 dB does not include MPI penalty. TxOMA2 and Launch Power (OMA-TDP) apply at maximum TDP. Power ≤4.5 W when stabilized (Tx and Rx CDR locked); may be ≤5 W during locking acquisition. Average launch power max 2.5 dBm with all channels on.
